title: Send the Property Management Agreement through DocuSign
detail:
About this step:
The PMA goes out within 1 business day of closing. Standard owners get the standard PMA. Active Owners get the Active Owner Program PMA.

Instructions:
1. Log into DocuSign as info@arealhomeaway.com (login in LastPass).
2. Choose the right PMA for the owner type and send it to every owner on the property.
3. Send the cover email below. If the home is owned by an LLC, keep the line about signing as the business.
4. Active Owner: the opportunity on this step releases when the PMA is sent. If the PMA was signed before the owner joined Resolve, use the Review your Property Management Agreement wording instead (2 hours).
5. Update the agreement status on the project to Sent.

Subject: Your Property Management Agreement for {property address}
Hi {owner first name},
We're looking forward to managing your home and working together.
Please review and sign the agreement sent to you through DocuSign at your earliest convenience. One quick note: please be sure to sign as your business entity, {LLC name}, rather than in your personal name.
If you have any questions at all, just let me know. We're happy to help.
Kindly,
{your name}

Done when:
The right PMA is sent to every owner and the status shows Sent.

Good to know:
Active Owner opportunity settings: response types Review / Acknowledge, Business Decision. Suggested time 1 hours. Release: when the PMA is sent.

If it stalls:
Not signed in 3 business days: send a short check-in and text the owner.

opportunity.how: Open the DocuSign email sent to you and read through the full agreement. If anything is unclear or you have questions before signing, reply to the email or leave a note here and we'll walk through it with you. Once you're comfortable, sign directly in DocuSign. No upload is needed here since DocuSign will send a completed copy to both of us.
opportunity.why: Your agreement reflects your participation in the Active Owner Program. Reviewing it closely ensures you understand your role, our responsibilities, and how we'll work together as your home launches and operates. A signed agreement keeps everything moving forward without delay.
opportunity.what: Review your Property Management Agreement for the Active Owner Program and sign it through DocuSign.
opportunity.title: Review and sign your Property Management Agreement

title: Coordinate the cost segregation study
detail:
Applies only when: Active Owner

About this step:
Active Owners only. The owner schedules their cost segregation study with their provider once staging is done, so every furnished element is documented in one walkthrough. Our onsite partner walks the provider through the home on a video call.

Instructions:
1. Fill in the window and onsite partner on this step's opportunity and release it once staging is complete.
2. The owner schedules the study and shares the date in their response. Resolve notifies you when they respond.
3. Schedule the onsite partner for that date and confirm it back to the owner.
4. No date after 3 business days: follow up with the owner.

Done when:
The owner has shared the study date and the onsite partner is scheduled.

Good to know:
Active Owner opportunity settings: response types Business Decision, Written Feedback. Suggested time 0.5 hours. Release: once staging is complete.

opportunity.how:
1. Schedule the study with your provider for the [X to X] window following staging.
2. Share the confirmed date and time here so we can coordinate [Onsite Partner]'s availability.
3. Let us know if your provider has any specific requirements for the walkthrough.
opportunity.why: Once staging is complete, the home is fully furnished and set up exactly as it will operate. Scheduling the study at this point allows every element of the home to be documented in one walkthrough, so nothing is missed and no follow up visit is needed.
opportunity.what: As part of your Active Owner Program, a cost segregation study is required for your home. Schedule the study with your provider for the [X to X] window following staging completion. The study is conducted on a video call, and [Onsite Partner], our onsite partner, will walk the provider through the entire home room by room. You do not need to be onsite.
opportunity.title: Schedule your cost segregation study walkthrough

title: Review the Pre-Work Inspection results
detail:
About this step:
The Pre-Work Inspection checks the home before work begins. It surfaces filters to order, interior cameras, garage remotes, and anything the owner needs to approve.

Instructions:
1. Open the results: https://www.notion.so/arealhomeaway/Pre-Work-Inspections-2c94658d5f4f80a0bcddcdb0577015ab
2. Order air filters in the sizes and quantities listed, and a refrigerator water filter if the fridge is not new. Add installation to a handyman work order.
3. Interior cameras: guests cannot have cameras inside. Get a handyman quote to remove them.
4. Garage remotes: if there are fewer than 2, order more and add programming to a work order.
5. Anything needing approval: Active Owners get the opportunity on this step. Standard owners get a short email listing what we found and what we recommend.
6. Tell the Onboarding Manager the results are reviewed so they can be added to the PID.

Done when:
Filters and remotes are ordered, cameras are handled, and owner approvals are requested.

Good to know:
Active Owner opportunity settings: response types Review / Acknowledge, Business Decision. Suggested time 0.25 hours. Release: after the Pre-Work Inspection. If nothing needs approval, remove that section and uncheck Business Decision.

opportunity.how:
1. Review the attached pre-work assessment.
2. Under Business Decision, approve each recommended item or let us know if you'd prefer another option.
3. Leave a note with any questions.
opportunity.why: Catching these items early keeps your home on schedule, avoids surprise costs later, and makes sure it meets listing site standards and guest expectations from day one.
opportunity.what:
Review the findings from our pre-work inspection of your home and approve any recommended changes.

Needs your approval:
[Item, what we found, what we recommend, and why. Repeat for each.]

Already completed:
[Small fixes handled during inspection and the benefit to you. Repeat for each.]

Everything else checked out: [systems that passed].
opportunity.title: Review your pre-work assessment
